Strata: the state of the record matched and the basis (school, district, roster); each stratum proportional, at least one. Each listing was read against its raw rows (name, section, status, the place fields the row carries), the station's market and the NCES record (name, city, county, grades; a district's schools). A verdict is correct when the row names that record's organization.
